name: com.ehking.sdk.wepay.ui.activity.AddBankCardActivity
description: When a user adds or verifies a bank card in PayEase Webox, this Activity collects the card number and mobile number, submits them, and continues to bank verification or SMS confirmation.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from adding or verifying cards and blocks the card check used during PayEase payment-password recovery.
